subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should the existing whole-run deadline become model-overridable, and what precedence should apply across defaults, named agents, model entries, and fallback candidates?
rationale: This adds compatibility-sensitive public configuration and changes timeout and fallback semantics; repository policy does not permit inferring that permanent contract from adjacent internal timers.

options.title: Model-overridable run deadline
options.body: Extend the existing non-resetting run budget with typed global and per-model values plus documented precedence and fallback behavior.

options.title: Separate generation deadline
options.body: Add an independent generation-only timer, accepting additional overlap with the existing whole-run budget.

options.title: No new timeout surface
options.body: Retain current run and provider controls and address runaway output only through narrower watchdog or repetition safeguards.

recommendation.title: Model-overridable run deadline
recommendation.body: Extend the existing non-resetting run budget with typed global and per-model values plus documented precedence and fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has both substantial timeout-policy history and the clearest public review ownership of the unresolved contract.
